gloss: mid-spring; the middle month of spring

definitions.gloss: mid-spring; the middle month of spring
definitions.explanation: The second month of spring in the traditional East Asian calendar, roughly corresponding to March in the modern calendar. The period when spring is in full swing.

examples.japanese: {仲春|ちゅうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}、⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}き→咲く：08150_saku⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: In mid-spring, the cherry blossoms begin to bloom.

examples.japanese: {仲春|ちゅうしゅん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{農作業|のうさぎょう}→農作業：14511_nousagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Mid-spring is the season when farm work begins.

examples.japanese: {仲春|ちゅうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk in the park under the warm mid-spring sunshine.

notes:
Composed of {仲|ちゅう} (middle) + {春|しゅん} (spring). Part of the traditional East Asian system of dividing each season into three sub-periods.

THE THREE SPRINGS:
- ⟦{初春|しょしゅん}→初春：21709_shoshun⟧: early spring (approximately February)
- {仲春|ちゅうしゅん}: mid-spring (approximately March)
- ⟦{晩春|ばんしゅん}→晩春：13093_banshun⟧: late spring (approximately April)

USAGE:
- Primarily literary and seasonal — used in formal correspondence, seasonal greetings, haiku, and classical literature
- In letters, {仲春|ちゅうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう} is a seasonal greeting phrase used in March
- The same pattern exists for all four seasons: {仲夏|ちゅうか}, {仲秋|ちゅうしゅう}, {仲冬|ちゅうとう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仲春|ちゅうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}: the mid-spring season (letter greeting)
- {仲春|ちゅうしゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}: around mid-spring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧: spring — the general everyday word
- ⟦{初春|しょしゅん}→初春：21709_shoshun⟧: early spring — the first part of spring
- ⟦{晩春|ばんしゅん}→晩春：13093_banshun⟧: late spring — the last part of spring
